registration_read.verdict: The FAR plane registers; the three nearer planes do not. Passing the plate as a conditioning image and repeating the camera brief verbatim holds the full-frame background, but every isolated-object layer is re-composed centred and enlarged.
by_object: far (room shell) REGISTERS: measured, the cutaway box's right edge lands at x=935 against the reference's x=957 (-22 px) and the wall/floor line at x=1400 sits at y=647 against y=648 (1 px). It is faithful geometry with simplified interior detail (two empty shelf bays where the reference has a full-width shelf plus the closet bay) and the emptying was obeyed - no furniture survived.

mid (shelving/TV/closet) DOES NOT REGISTER: delivered opaque with a painted checkerboard, drawn as one centred cluster rather than at the reference's shelf coordinates; the closet contents are duplicated beside the group. No pixel bbox is quotable - the painted background defeats a mask.

subject (sofa/lamp/table) DOES NOT REGISTER: delivered opaque with a painted checkerboard; the sofa is drawn roughly 2.4x the reference's size, centred, more side-on than the reference's three-quarter view, with the side table on the other hand and an unrequested potted plant added.

near (rowing machine) DOES NOT REGISTER: the only true-alpha asset of this plate. Alpha bbox x 42-1505, y 163-891 (1463x728 px) against the reference machine read at roughly x 330-760, y 760-990 (about 430x230 px): about 3.4x too large, centre offset about (+228, -348) px, and redrawn from a different angle (handle left in the reference, rotated here).
registration_read.translation_search: the +-42 px gradient-correlation search returns (0,0) for far and saturates for mid, subject and near - their mismatch is scale and re-composition, not a translation any shift could fix.

style_drift_read: Style holds; geometry does not. Across the four the register is consistent - carved woodblock contours, the same flat editorial palette (cream, charcoal, steel blue, teal, copper), matte, upper-left light, comparable ink weight. The only style faults: the near layer carries a soft glow/gradient on the flywheel that the register bans, and the subject layer adds an unrequested potted plant. Route (a)'s named risk was style drift across four generations; the measured risk is REGISTRATION drift.
route_finding: Through the claims pipeline the generating agent's only image capability is codex's built-in image_gen.imagegen. It exposes NO model, quality, size or background parameter: the model that actually generated is gpt-image 2.0 (read from the delivered PNG's C2PA metadata), not GPT Image 2.5, and 'transparent background' can only be asked for in prose. Asked in prose, the model PAINTS a checkerboard instead of returning alpha: 6 of 9 delivered assets came back opaque RGB with a drawn grey/white checkerboard, and only 2 of 6 transparent slots ever returned a real alpha channel (1 on attempt 1, 1 on the single re-roll).
alpha_clean_rule: Cleaned only the true-alpha assets: alpha<=12 (a stray veil) and half-transparent pixels that are near-white (min channel >=248) or near-black (max <=6) go to alpha 0; the antialias rim is kept (doc 24). Opaque deliveries were NOT hand-matted (brief rule).
